image.creator: Michelangelo
image.attribution: Michelangelo, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: Michelangelo painted Dante's Minos, serpent coiled around him, into the Sistine Chapel: proof of how far Dante's version travelled

summary.en: Legendary king of Crete, son of Zeus and Europa. In classical myth he became one of the judges of the dead.

en: Husband of Pasiphaë and father of Ariadne
Homer's Odyssey and Virgil's Aeneid both show him judging the dead
